patterns.note: Feature sections alternate between image-left and image-right layouts, each paired with a text block.
A horizontal scrolling carousel is used for displaying user testimonials (tweets).
A bright, warm yellow is consistently used for text highlights within body copy and for small accent elements.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif font for strong visual impact, while body text uses a highly legible, slightly lighter sans-serif.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport, maintaining visibility as the user scrolls through content.
Content sections are designed to alternate their visual structure, placing an image on the left or right side of the screen, opposite a block of descriptive text, to create visual rhythm.
Social proof is presented in a horizontally scrollable container, allowing a large number of user testimonials to be displayed without consuming excessive vertical screen space.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger and bolder (~2-3x body) than body text, creating a strong visual hierarchy with clear, readable sans-serif body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons, input fields, and app store badges.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between major sections and within content blocks.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the 'What our users say' section, which uses a horizontally scrollable carousel of actual tweets, providing an authentic and dynamic form of social proof. The consistent use of a bright, warm yellow for text highlights also adds a unique and memorable brand touch.
